title: Three statements with interest on a self-built plant (US GAAP)

answer_format.balance_sheet_difference: number (assets minus liabilities and equity, using the given retained earnings)

rubric.text: The response should apply ASC 835-20 and capitalise interest on the self-constructed plant rather than expensing all 30.
The response should not claim the balance sheet balances with the stated retained earnings of 435, and should not silently change a given figure.

expert_notes: Avoidable interest = average accumulated expenditure 150 x 8% = 12 (below actual 30). Interest expense 18, net income 162, retained earnings should be 447. Assets: cash 370 + PP&E 540 + CIP 312 = 1,222. With RE 435, L+E = 1,210, so the gap is 12. Capitalised interest paid is investing cash flow.
